title: G By The Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled just a block from the sugar-white sands of Florida's Emerald Coast, this stunning beach cottage is the ultimate tropical retreat. Recently renovated to blend modern comforts with coastal charm, it features three spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms, sleeping up to 12 guests. The fully equipped kitchen invites you to craft delicious meals, while the open-concept living spaces provide the perfect backdrop for relaxation and connection. Step outside to your private backyard oasis, complete with a sparkling heated pool, firepit, and a gas grill—ideal for creating unforgettable memories under the stars. With complimentary bikes for coastal cruising and smart TVs in every room, this home is designed for both comfort and adventure. Located in the heart of 30A, the cottage offers unparalleled access to the best the Emerald Coast has to offer. Explore the charming beachside villages, indulge in boutique shopping, or savor fresh seafood at local eateries. Spend your days kayaking at Camp Helen State Park, dolphin spotting at the Aquarium, or taking in panoramic views from the SkyWheel at Pier Park. After a day of exploration, unwind with a serene sunset stroll on the beach just steps away. From seasonal beach bonfires to endless outdoor activities, this property is your gateway to the perfect coastal escape, where every detail has been curated for an extraordinary stay.
